import sys, json, time, resource, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from formats import read_request
from pipeline import execute

motifs=[]
for i in range(1024):
    motifs.append([1515 + (i % 13), 1516 + (i % 7)]*8)
disc=[]
for m in motifs:
    for _ in range(2):
        vals=[0]*24+list(m)+[0]*24
        acts=[0]*24+[100]*16+[0]*24
        disc.append({'class':0,'values':vals,'activation':acts})
validation=[]
for r in range(128):
    body=[]
    for k in range(8):
        body += motifs[(r*8+k) % 1024]
    validation.append({'class':0,'values':body[:128]})
rel={'id':'m','classes':1,'width':16,'eps':[1,1],'ratio':[1,1024],'threshold':[0,1],
     'mode':'range','packet_limit':200000,'idle_us':10**12,
     'discovery':disc,'train':[{'class':0,'values':[1515]*16}],
     'validation':validation}
blocks=[[['install','m']]]
nflow=8192; per=24; extra=3392
ops=1
for f in range(nflow):
    fid='f%d'%f
